verbatim_quote.english_translation: I restarted (OpenCode, so the new MCP servers/skills load).

extracted_decision.summary: Restart handshake: Hands prepares everything (env, global sync, timeouts), tells manager to restart OpenCode, verifies post-restart state (mcp list 7/7) before live testing.
extracted_decision.rationale: Config/server changes only take effect after an OpenCode restart, which only the manager can perform.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: One restart round-trip per infra change in exchange for verified live state.
